retired_records.question_text: Original Practice Question — Given the inequalities: G < A, A >= F, F <= E, E > C, C <= B. Which one of the following conclusions must be true?
retired_records.explanation: Across all numeric assignments satisfying the statements (G < A; A >= F; F <= E; E > C; C <= B), the conclusion C <= B is true; exhaustive finite order-model enumeration found it entailed. Each of the other four options fails in at least one satisfying assignment, so none is necessarily true.
